Compare a first-time viewer's understanding of a promo clip with the truth.
TRUTH (from the show bible, for episodes E12): Premise: [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
Mayor Brisk (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 53 lines between E1 and E14
Widow Halloran (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 45 lines between E1 and E14
Tobin The Ferryman (a man in period dress): [mock] speaks 40 lines between E1 and E14
Mara (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 28 lines between E1 and E14
Arc [mock] Part 4: A storm traps the whole family in the lighthouse overnight.
E12: Corin is arrested for a murder from before his drowning.
CLIP: [On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
a figure in period dress (off-screen): "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
[On screen: Medium two-shot of the man in period dress and the figure in period dress, the space between them charged.]
a figure in period dress: "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
a figure in period dress: "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a man in period dress: "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress: "I never stole from anyone in my life!"
VIEWER ANSWERS: {"main_character":"a figure in period dress","what_they_want":"[mock] to be believed and get out of this moment","conflict":"[mock] pressure from a figure in period dress (off-screen)","left_wondering":"[mock] what comes after: \"I never stole from anyone in my life!\"","need_next":3,"confusing":["Ashvale","Every","Lord"]}
Return ONLY JSON: {"who": 0|1, "want": 0|0.5|1, "conflict": 0|0.5|1, "open_question": 0|1, "notes": "<= 20 words"}
"open_question" = 1 only if the viewer names a specific unresolved question the clip sets up.
